Any reason for using a ScrollBar?
You can use a base Range node. `scroll_to()` is the same as `set_value()`, `scroll(delta)` is the same as `set_value(get_value() + delta)`. The only difference is that ScrollBar also emits signal, but you don't even use it.

You could also get rid of the internal node and do the calculations directly, but I guess Range makes it easier to use.

This implementation is weird. Since `continuous_scroll` is enabled by default, the internal node will _always_ be created. Disabling the property will only free it after creating. So why not make this property a regular `bool` and never free the node? It makes little difference.
